sources.title: Linear composition and positive-side sensitivity
sources.details: For scalar x, 3(2x)=6x; 3(2x)^2=12x² gives 12 and 48 for x=1,2. For column vectors B(Ax)=(BA)x by associativity. ReLU²=max(0,x)², positive derivative 2x; x=1 ->1 and x=2 ->4. All verified by bounded CPU code; statements concern activations rather than full-model quality.

claims.statement: Pure matrix layers compose into one linear transformation; MLP inserts elementwise nonlinear activation between feature transformations.
claims.scope: Only pure matrix maps and pointwise activation; no claim that the full attention model is linear.

evidence.supports: Nonlinear activation needed to avoid deep linear classifier.
